name: Identity, Tenant & Clinical Access Boundary

hazardCase.hazardousCondition: A session, query or command reads or writes clinical data of another tenant, or acts without a verified session, scope and purpose.
foreseeableSequence: token forged or reused across tenants
query without tenant context or pool running as BYPASSRLS owner
PHI of another clinic returned or modified
hazardCase.potentialHarm: Unauthorized disclosure or alteration of PHI across organizations.

controls.name: Verified session + mandatory scope/purpose authorization (runtime-auth) and forced RLS under the NOBYPASSRLS runtime role

invariants.statement: Every request executes only with a verified session whose tenant matches, a mandatory scope and the declared purpose; every database access runs under the tenant's RLS context (NOBYPASSRLS role); cross-tenant access fails closed.

safetyArgument: Authority establishes intended behavior and boundaries.
Controls prevent, detect, correct, or recover from those conditions.
Invariants define conditions that must remain true.
Tests provide executable oracles; execution evidence is separately required.
Capability remains blocked when any required safety-case element is absent.
